description: This file manages gateway configuration reloading, including diffing config paths, resolving reload settings, and orchestrating hot reloads or restarts based on file changes. It uses chokidar for file watching and provides functions to start and stop the reloader.

classes.name: GatewayConfigReloader
classes.description: An interface representing a gateway configuration reloader with a stop method.

methods.name: diffConfigPaths
methods.description: Compares two configuration objects and returns the paths that differ.

methods.name: resolveGatewayReloadSettings
methods.description: Determines reload settings based on the current configuration.

methods.name: startGatewayConfigReloader
methods.description: Initializes and starts the gateway configuration reloader with specified options.
